name: Behalf.bot - VCL runner
description: Runs a student's queued Vibecode Lisboa Hub jobs on their own install, through the local `claude -p` on their own Claude plan, instead of on an API key. A heartbeat claims each job from the Hub, runs every step with no tools in an empty directory, and posts the raw answers back; the Hub builds every prompt and checks every answer. Ships no course content: the skill and prompts arrive with each job.

enabled.description: Master switch. The runner also does nothing until `vcl-runner setup` has stored an agent key.

agent_base_url.description: Hub the runner claims jobs from. Override only to test against a staging or local Hub; plain http is accepted for localhost only. Exported as FOUNDER_OS_AGENT_BASE_URL.

agent_key.description: The vcl_fos_ agent key from the Hub settings (runner: My BehalfBot). Empty (the default) means the runner does nothing. Set it with `vcl-runner setup`, which writes FOUNDER_OS_AGENT_KEY to the install's .env (the file the dispatcher sources before every gather); never put it in chassis.config.yaml or any committed file. Deliberately not in contracts.env, so an activation-time export of an empty value can never shadow the real key.

activation._note: The one scheduled job is the vcl-runner heartbeat, and it is opt-in twice: it must be added to the install's HEARTBEATS.md (block in README.md), and it does nothing until `vcl-runner setup` has stored an agent key. The gate does the work itself: with nothing queued it is one HTTP request and zero tokens, and the dispatcher's own model fires only when the key is rejected or the claude CLI is missing.

system.name: python3
system.install: apt-get install python3 (Debian) / your platform's package manager

system.name: claude
system.install: Claude Code, installed and logged in on the account that runs the heartbeat (run `claude` once)
system._explanation: Every job step runs through `claude -p` on the student's own login.

network_egress: agent_base_url (https://vibecodelisboa.com by default) - GET /api/founder-os/agent/jobs/next and POST /api/founder-os/agent/jobs/:id/result on each heartbeat tick, only when an agent key is set
_declares.credentials: FOUNDER_OS_AGENT_KEY, read from the environment only and sent only as the Bearer header to agent_base_url. Never logged, never passed to the claude child process. The runner never reads ~/.claude, the keychain or any OAuth credential: it starts the claude CLI the student already logged into, with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY removed from the child's environment so the work bills the student's Claude plan.
_declares.subprocesses: claude -p --output-format json --tools "" --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources "" --disable-slash-commands --no-session-persistence --append-system-prompt <skill> [--model <model>], prompt on stdin, in an empty temporary directory. No tools and no MCP servers.
filesystem: ${CUSTOMER_HOME}/.env (and .env.baked when present) - written by `vcl-runner setup` only, mode 0600
a temporary empty directory per claude call, removed afterwards
